description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementDao class within the OrangeHRM system, handling data access operations related to leave entitlements, including CRUD operations, calculations of leave balances, and reporting functionalities in the Human Resource Management context.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDao
classes.description: Data access object handling leave entitlement related database operations, including CRUD, balance calculations, and report generation within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: getPendingStatusIds
methods.description: Returns the list of status IDs that represent pending leave requests.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Retrieves a list of leave entitlements matching given filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave entitlement records matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsSum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of leave days for leave entitlements matching the filter.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Fetches a specific leave entitlement by its ID.

methods.name: saveLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Persists a leave entitlement record, handling transactions and linking unused leave.

methods.name: getExistingLeaveEntitlementIds
methods.description: Returns list of existing leave entitlement IDs from provided list, excluding deleted ones.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsByIds
methods.description: Fetches leave entitlement records matching a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Marks specified leave entitlements as deleted.

methods.name: bulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Bulk assigns leave entitlements to multiple employees, handling new and existing records within a transaction.

methods.name: getValidLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Retrieves valid leave entitlements for an employee within a date range.

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns a leave balance object for an employee and leave type as at a specific date.

methods.name: getEntitlementUsageForLeave
methods.description: Provides leave entitlement usage details for a specific leave record.

methods.name: getLeaveTypesForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Returns leave types relevant for entitlement usage report based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveTypesCountForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Returns the count of leave types relevant for entitlement usage report.

methods.name: getEmployeesForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Retrieves employees matching entitlement usage report filter.

methods.name: getEmployeesCountForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Returns count of employees matching entitlement usage report filter.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIdsForEntitlementsByEmployee
methods.description: Fetches leave type IDs for entitlements filtered by employee and date range.
